description:
Perform a complete multiple linear regression analysis on the Exam Anxiety dataset. 

1. Open '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ExamAnxiety.csv' in Jamovi.
2. Run a Linear Regression with 'Exam' as the Dependent Variable, and 'Anxiety' and 'Revise' as Covariates.
3. Enable the following diagnostic options:
   - Model Fit: R, R-squared, Adjusted R-squared
   - Model Coefficients: Standardized estimate, Confidence interval
   - Assumption Checks: Collinearity statistics, Q-Q plot of residuals, Residual plots, Durbin-Watson, Cook's distance
4. Save the Jamovi project as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ExamAnxiety_Diagnostics.omv'.
5. Create a text report at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/diagnostics_report.txt' extracting these exact values (rounded to 3 decimal places):

FORMAT:
MODEL FIT
R-squared: [value]
Adjusted R-squared: [value]

COEFFICIENTS
Anxiety: B=[value], Beta=[value], p=[value]
Revise: B=[value], Beta=[value], p=[value]

COLLINEARITY
Anxiety VIF: [value]
Revise VIF: [value]

AUTOCORRELATION
Durbin-Watson: [value]
